Container.Name: gMKVExtractGUI
Container.Overview: Extract Matroska tracks and metadata in a TigerVNC desktop. Open the WebUI for browser access or connect with a native VNC client.

Config.Name: VNC Port
Config.Description: VNC server port. Connect with a VNC client to the Unraid host on this port.

Config.Name: VNC WebUI Port
Config.Description: noVNC browser interface. Open the container WebUI to connect.

Config.Name: VNC Password
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to disable VNC authentication; only do this on a trusted network. Passwords must be 6-8 characters.

Config.Name: Home / app config
Config.Description: Persists language preference and app configuration.

Config.Name: Media input
Config.Description: Media files. Read/write is required when saving extracts beside input files.

Config.Name: Extraction output
Config.Description: Destination for extracted tracks and metadata.

Config.Name: HOME
Config.Description: Container home directory; keep this mapped to /config for persistent settings.
